TLR.Title: The Long Rest
TLR.Settings.MenuHint: Connect this world to your campaign in The Long Rest.
TLR.Settings.Intro: Paste a VTT connector token from The Long Rest (Campaign Settings → API access).
TLR.Settings.TokenWarning: The token is saved only in this browser. Other modules installed in this world can read it, which is why it must be a VTT connector token: it can't change your campaign. Revoke it in The Long Rest if you uninstall this module.
TLR.Settings.ShareNpcHp: Share exact NPC and monster HP (off: only whether they're down)
TLR.Settings.AnnounceReveals: Announce newly revealed facts in chat
TLR.Import.Misses: {count} actor(s) had fields this dnd5e version stored differently; check them.
TLR.Import.Errors: The Long Rest: {count} actor(s) couldn't be imported; see the console.
TLR.Import.Empty: The Long Rest: nothing player-visible in this session yet. In The Long Rest: set NPCs to Card only or Full details and attach them to a beat, link combat beats to encounters, or reveal a fact. Beats and DM notes always stay in The Long Rest.
TLR.Import.BasicActors: The Long Rest: {count} combatant(s) had no Bestiary entry and came in as basic actors (AC, HP and attacks as text).
TLR.Import.ButtonTooltip: Import session prep from The Long Rest (the running session)
TLR.Import.Removed: The Long Rest: removed {count} NPC(s) that are no longer visible in The Long Rest (and their tokens).
TLR.Import.NoSessions: The Long Rest: no sessions in this campaign yet. Create one in The Long Rest, then import.
